protocol:
1. Set up an Invitrogen E-Gel EX Agarose 1% cassette on the bench with the comb removed, keeping labeled microcentrifuge tubes chilled in an ice bucket and using a micropipette with disposable tips.

2. Open a chilled labeled microcentrifuge tube and use the micropipette to transfer an aliquot of clear liquid from the tube into a well of the E-Gel EX Agarose 1% cassette.

3. Return the tube to the ice bucket and repeat the aliquot transfer from additional chilled labeled microcentrifuge tubes into separate wells of the E-Gel EX cassette.

4. Place the loaded E-Gel EX Agarose 1% cassette into the Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap electrophoresis/imaging unit.

5. Close the orange lid of the E-Gel Power Snap over the inserted cassette.

6. Select the E-Gel EX run program on the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen.

7. Start the electrophoresis run on the E-Gel Power Snap with the visible run timer set to 10:00 min.
